criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Value register works and nothing is faded; frames 2 and 6 pass the showstopper test. Primitive models carry 3 and 8, plates sit behind the counter on 4 and the cite line on 7, the hero is a plain white box on 1 and 4 and about 45 px on 5, frame 9 keeps a clipped window strip and a book bridging a nosing, frame 6 has a stray ring and a flat tab, and frame 1's nosings read as flat stripes.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One grade, one field, one accent with one meaning; the stair bookends from foot, side and top and the transcript changes state. The hero is effectively absent on 2 and 5, the key changes character, and frame 5's stair has no building at its top.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every string traces; 18 months and 495 days check; eight of nine and five of twenty are drawn correctly; Rule 203.6(a) matches c28 and c29. The strike, its reason, the objection timing and the Ninth District rest on journalism, and c2 is carried from a September 7th fetch.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and status are clear and slide 6 turns the story. No frame gives a next step or the case number, and the cost stake is only in the Chief Justice's line.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The hook earns the swipe, 6 turns, 7 is the strongest beat, 9 closes. 3 restates 2 and 4 overlaps 5.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register. Frame 4's 'The company had asked' dangles, frame 7's 'Then he asked it' is mannered, and 'Drawn to illustrate' and 'Courthouse News reports' repeat as tics.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The topic is fresh and the stair is new, but lastLight, bluebonnet, a statute page on a desk and a courtroom interior all appear in the last ten days.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the transcript as a real bound object with a clear cover, posts and fanned leaves, raked by the key, and stage it at a third of the frame on 3, 5 and 8.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive camcorder dominates; transcript small with its leader across its cover; brown mid tone wall.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn the camera so a lens faces the reader, bring the transcript forward into the window rake at 600 px or more, and drop the room fill.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Evenly lit greeked bars on a box lectern, flat blue seal, flat rail tiles, no rake.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake a low bench light from the left so the far leaf falls into shadow; emboss the seal; bevel the rail in brushed brass.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Dark plate behind the cite line over the transcript; tiny justices; empty floor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the cite wash, shift the lectern so the transcript clears the footer, lower the camera so the bench fills the middle third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Transcript about 45 px, flat stair side, dead bottom fifth.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the stair's near end into the left third with a lower eye so the transcript reaches 120 px; cut joints into the side; tilt down to fill the bottom band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Clipped window strip at the top edge; book bridges a nosing.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pitch the camera down so the strip leaves the frame and seat the book on one tread.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Plate behind the counter; transcript a plain box; flat lit window.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the plate, cap the floodlight so the tower's corner falls dark behind the counter, give the window a mullioned glow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Risers not dark, nosings flat stripes, transcript a white box, doors read as display cases.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the key so risers fall into shadow, bevel the nosings, give the transcript its cover and posts.
